scientific limitations/integrity: The theorem uses the natural global-over-n interpretation of the motivating paper's informal word 'amplitude'. It proves global unboundedness and signed range only; it does not give finite-x extremal rates, distribution laws, or a complete zero-set classification for k>=2. The proof is symbolic; finite computations are regression checks rather than evidence for the infinite quantifiers.
title: The Bouderbala--Karras divisor discrepancy has infinite global amplitude
